# run-dev-graph-node

## Purpose & Output Contract

- 入力: C24 で containment 検証済みの artifact candidate、既存 graph snapshot、または exact-13 package。
- 出力: C02 単一 writer 経由で atomic 登録された typed node/package と revision/digest receipt。
- 完了条件: kind/path/frontmatter/dependency が schema と一致し、package は P01..P13 exact-set のときだけ applied count 13 となる。

全 graph/content write の単一 writer。通常 artifact は issue/task/specification/architecture/document、macro feature は C14 由来のみを `features/` に登録する。

## Classification and write

1. C24 resolver で全 read/write realpath の containment を検証する。
2. 内容から `artifact_kind/domain/project_id`、候補 path、confidence/reason/second candidate を preview する。confidence>=0.80 かつ margin>=0.15 は自動確定し、それ以外だけユーザー確認する。保存先は質問しない。
3. `template-contract.json` から kind template を選ぶ。architecture は subtype 全件、specification は API 変更時だけ api-contract overlay を合成する。
4. frontmatter/body/path と graph node を一時領域で構成し `validate-graph-schema.py` を通してから atomic replace する。更新は既存本文を全置換せず不足 section/変更 field だけを更新する。物理削除は禁止。

## Exact-13 package gate

`register-package` verb はこの gate の実装本体 `../../scripts/register-package.py` に委譲する (`register-package --package <path> --graph <path> --output <path> --receipt <path>`、事前検査は `preflight`)。単一 writer は `register-package.py` が fcntl ロックと receipt の `os.link` 一回性で保証し、skill 側は入力整形と結果提示に留める。

system-dev-planner の package は P01..P13 exact set、13 node、共通 `parent_feature`/`feature_package_id`、同一 package 内だけの DAG、source digest、tracker binding を commit 前に検証する。12/14件、phase 重複/欠落、mixed parent/package、cross-feature edge は `applied_count=0` で拒否する。成功 receipt は `status/source_digest/expected_count=13/applied_count=13/graph_revision/registered_node_ids/committed_at` を持ち immutable に保存する (schema: `../../schemas/package-registration-receipt.schema.json`)。

`--dry-run` は local/external write 0。失敗時に一部 node を残さない。

## Execution-context consumer

C27 の claim saga は `register-package.py execution-context --graph <path> --graph-node-id <id> --context-json <json>` を内部 consumer として必ず実行する。この入口も C02 単一 writer の lock・graph-node schema 検証・atomic replace を共有し、同一 `worktree_id` の context を冪等置換する。C27 が receipt を自作・持込みせず、consumer が返す `owner=C02/run-dev-graph-node`、`operation=project_execution_context`、`status=applied`、node/worktree identity 一致を確認してから claim を確定する。

## ゴールシーク実行

### ゴール (Goal)

通常5 artifactを自動分類し、C14由来featureとsystem-dev-planner由来exact 13 phase tasksをそれぞれの専用契約で正規pathへatomic追加・更新し、graph/frontmatter/body/path/package整合を保つ

### 目的・背景 (Why)

成果物を単一graphで保持する専用writer。feature由来task batchはsystem-dev-plannerのfeature package契約に従い、P01..P13 exact 13 node、共通parent_feature/feature_package_id、同一package内dependencyを事前検証してall-or-none commitする。tracker bindingも同じtransactionで解決する

### 完了チェックリスト

- [ ] 全 read/write realpath が resolved repo root 内で repository_id が一致する
- [ ] classification decision が閾値による自動確定または明示 user confirmation の証跡を持つ
- [ ] 通常 artifact の frontmatter/body/path/template metadata が schema と一致する
- [ ] package は P01..P13 exact 13、共通 parent/package、内部 DAG を満たし、違反時 applied_count が0である
- [ ] 成功 receipt の graph_revision と registered_node_ids が commit 後 graph と一致する

### ゴールシークループ

frontmatter の `goal_seek.engine: inline` / `fork: subagent` / `max_loops: 5` を実行契約とする。固定手順は使わず、未達 checklist と担当 `prompts/*.md` からその周回の操作を都度生成する。各周回で inner criterion を検証し、完了後は outer criterion の live trial/content review を最大 `feedback_contract.max_iterations=3` 周で評価する。

- `criteria:IN1`: `validate-graph-schema.py` の書込み前検証で必須キー欠落が0件である。

- feature は C14 の macro contract から受け取り、通常 artifact routing で新規生成しない。

{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "$id": "feature-execution-package.schema.json",
  "title": "One feature to exact 13 executable task package",
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": ["schema_version", "feature_package_id", "parent_feature", "source_feature_digest", "task_count", "phase_refs", "task_spec_paths", "task_node_ids"],
  "properties": {
    "schema_version": {"const": "1.0.0"},
    "feature_package_id": {"type": "string", "pattern": "^feature-package/[A-Za-z0-9._/-]+$"},
    "parent_feature": {"type": "string", "minLength": 1},
    "source_feature_digest": {"type": "string", "pattern": "^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$"},
    "task_count": {"const": 13},
    "phase_refs": {"const": ["P01", "P02", "P03", "P04", "P05", "P06", "P07", "P08", "P09", "P10", "P11", "P12", "P13"]},
    "task_spec_paths": {
      "type": "array",
      "minItems": 13,
      "maxItems": 13,
      "prefixItems": [
        {"const": "task-specs/phase-01-requirements.md"},
        {"const": "task-specs/phase-02-architecture.md"},
        {"const": "task-specs/phase-03-design-review.md"},
        {"const": "task-specs/phase-04-test-design.md"},
        {"const": "task-specs/phase-05-implementation.md"},
        {"const": "task-specs/phase-06-test-run.md"},
        {"const": "task-specs/phase-07-acceptance.md"},
        {"const": "task-specs/phase-08-refactoring-migration.md"},
        {"const": "task-specs/phase-09-quality-assurance.md"},
        {"const": "task-specs/phase-10-final-review.md"},
        {"const": "task-specs/phase-11-evidence.md"},
        {"const": "task-specs/phase-12-documentation-operations.md"},
        {"const": "task-specs/phase-13-release-deploy.md"}
      ],
      "items": false
    },
    "task_node_ids": {
      "type": "array",
      "minItems": 13,
      "maxItems": 13,
      "uniqueItems": true,
      "items": {"type": "string", "minLength": 1}
    }
  }
}

{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "$id": "dev-graph-registration.schema.json",
  "type": "object",
  "required": ["schema_version", "source_digest", "promotion_receipt", "feature_package_id", "parent_feature", "expected_count", "phase_refs", "binding_intents", "nodes"],
  "properties": {
    "schema_version": {"const": "1.0.0"},
    "source_digest": {"type": "string", "pattern": "^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$"},
    "promotion_receipt": {"type": "string", "pattern": "^(?!/)(?!.*(?:^|/)\\.\\.(?:/|$)).+$"},
    "feature_package_id": {"type": "string", "pattern": "^feature-package/[A-Za-z0-9._/-]+$"},
    "parent_feature": {"type": "string", "minLength": 1},
    "expected_count": {"const": 13},
    "phase_refs": {"const": ["P01", "P02", "P03", "P04", "P05", "P06", "P07", "P08", "P09", "P10", "P11", "P12", "P13"]},
    "binding_intents": {
      "type": "object",
      "minProperties": 13,
      "maxProperties": 13,
      "additionalProperties": {"type": "string", "enum": ["auto", "beads", "github", "none"]},
      "description": "key=graph_node_id。C02 deterministic checkがkeys exact-set == nodes[].graph_node_idおよびexpected_count == nodes lengthを検査する。mode=bothではautoを拒否する"
    },
    "nodes": {
      "type": "array",
      "minItems": 13,
      "maxItems": 13,
      "description": "exact 13 P01..P13 nodes; validate-system-plan enforces phase exact-set and common parent/package",
      "items": {
        "allOf": [
          {"$ref": "../../dev-graph/schemas/graph-node.schema.json"},
          {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "artifact_kind": {"const": "task"},
              "artifact_subtypes": {"maxItems": 0},
              "parent_feature": {"type": "string", "minLength": 1},
              "feature_package_id": {"type": "string", "pattern": "^feature-package/[A-Za-z0-9._/-]+$"},
              "phase_ref": {"type": "string", "pattern": "^P(0[1-9]|1[0-3])$"},
              "file_path": {"type": "string", "pattern": "^tasks/.+\\.md$"},
              "status": {"const": "active"},
              "template_id": {"const": "task"},
              "confirmation_status": {"const": "confirmed"},
              "evaluation_status": {"const": "pass"},
              "issue_linkage": {"type": "null"},
              "tracker_binding": {"const": "repo-config-default"},
              "beads_linkage": {"type": "null"},
              "github_project_linkages": {"maxItems": 0},
              "pull_request_linkages": {"maxItems": 0},
              "execution_contexts": {"maxItems": 0},
              "completion_evidence": {
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {
                  "policy": {"enum": ["linked_pr_merged_all", "linked_pr_merged_any"]},
                  "status": {"const": "in_progress"},
                  "source": {"type": "null"},
                  "completed_at": {"type": "null"},
                  "reconciled_at": {"type": "null"},
                  "evidence_refs": {"maxItems": 0}
                }
              },
              "source_lineage": {
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {"origin_kind": {"const": "system-dev-planner"}}
              },
              "implementation_readiness": {
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {"status": {"const": "complete"}}
              }
            }
          }
        ]
      }
    }
  },
  "additionalProperties": false
}

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Author the upstream (system-dev-planner side) inputs that C02 register-package.py consumes.

This script does NOT perform any C02 responsibility: it neither builds graph node
records into the graph, nor takes the writer lock, nor performs the atomic replace,
nor emits the registration receipt. All of that is done by
plugins/dev-graph/scripts/register-package.py when it is executed afterwards.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

REPO = Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve(strict=True)
NOW = "2026-09-07T04:35:00Z"
FEATURE = "LT-FEATURE-001"
PACKAGE_ID = "feature-package/LT-FEATURE-001"
PLANNER_VERSION = "0.1.11"
PKG_DIR_REL = ".dev-graph/cache/system-dev-planner/LT-FEATURE-001"

PHASES = [
    ("P01", "phase-01-requirements", "要件確定", "実装対象の要件を確定し、受入条件を検証可能な形に固定する"),
    ("P02", "phase-02-architecture", "アーキテクチャ設計", "描画経路の container 分割と決定論制約を設計として固定する"),

    ("P04", "phase-04-test-design", "テスト設計", "決定論と参照整合を検証するテスト観点を設計する"),
    ("P05", "phase-05-implementation", "実装", "canonical graph から静的 HTML を生成する経路を実装する"),

            out.append(yaml_dump(value, indent + 2))
        elif isinstance(value, list):

def frontmatter(phase: str, slug: str, jp: str, purpose: str, prev: str | None, digest: str,
                source_digest_hex: str, status: str) -> dict:
    nid = node_id(phase)

        "project_id": "gm4r2-render",

        "status": status,

        "owners": ["harness maintainers"],

        "file_path": f"tasks/{FEATURE}/{slug}.md",
        "template_id": "task",
        "template_version": "1.0.0",
        "confirmation_status": "confirmed",
        "evaluation_status": "pass",
        "confirmation_evidence": {

            "evidence_ref": f"{PKG_DIR_REL}/atomic-promotion-receipt.json",
            "evaluated_digest": digest,
        },
        "source_lineage": {

            "source_plugin": "system-dev-planner",
            "source_path": f"{PKG_DIR_REL}/task-specs/{slug}.md",

        "related_nodes": [FEATURE],

        "scope_in": [f"{jp}の担当範囲の成果物作成", "受入条件に対応する検証の実施"],
        "scope_out": ["他 phase の担当範囲への変更", "graph store の直接編集"],
        "acceptance": ["成果物が存在し後続 phase が参照できる", "C11 gate が violations 0 件で通る"],

def yaml_scalar(value) -> str:
    if value is None:
        return "null"
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return "true" if value else "false"
    if isinstance(value, (int, float)):
        return repr(value)
    return json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False)


def yaml_dump(mapping: dict, indent: int = 0) -> str:
    pad = " " * indent
    out = []
    for key, value in mapping.items():
        if isinstance(value, dict):
            out.append(f"{pad}{key}:")
            out.append(yaml_dump(value, indent + 2))
        elif isinstance(value, list):
            out.append(f"{pad}{key}: " + json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False))
        else:
            out.append(f"{pad}{key}: {yaml_scalar(value)}")
    return "\n".join(out)


def main() -> int:
    tasks_dir = REPO / "tasks" / FEATURE
    pkg_dir = REPO / PKG_DIR_REL
    spec_dir = pkg_dir / "task-specs"
    tasks_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    spec_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    bodies: dict[str, str] = {}
    for index, (phase, slug, jp, purpose) in enumerate(PHASES):
        prev = PHASES[index - 1][0] if index else None
        text = body(phase, slug, jp, purpose, prev)
        bodies[phase] = text
        (spec_dir / f"{slug}.md").write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")

    # source_digest of the promoted plan = digest over the ordered task spec bodies.
    hasher = hashlib.sha256()
    for phase, slug, _jp, _p in PHASES:
        hasher.update(slug.encode("utf-8"))
        hasher.update(bodies[phase].encode("utf-8"))
    source_digest_hex = hasher.hexdigest()
    source_digest = f"sha256:{source_digest_hex}"
    feature_digest = "sha256:" + hashlib.sha256(
        (REPO / "features" / f"{FEATURE}.md").read_bytes()).hexdigest()

    nodes = []
    for index, (phase, slug, jp, purpose) in enumerate(PHASES):
        prev = PHASES[index - 1][0] if index else None
        artifact = tasks_dir / f"{slug}.md"
        text = bodies[phase]
        digest = hashlib.sha256(text.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
        # registration always carries the active/in_progress shape; completion is a
        # later C02 update, never part of the package commit.
        front = frontmatter(phase, slug, jp, purpose, prev, digest, source_digest_hex, "active")
        artifact.write_text("---\n" + yaml_dump(front) + "\n---\n\n" + text, encoding="utf-8")
        nodes.append(front)

    package = {
        "schema_version": "1.0.0",
        "feature_package_id": PACKAGE_ID,
        "parent_feature": FEATURE,
        "source_feature_digest": feature_digest,
        "task_count": 13,
        "phase_refs": [p for p, _s, _j, _u in PHASES],
        "task_spec_paths": [f"task-specs/{slug}.md" for _p, slug, _j, _u in PHASES],
        "task_node_ids": [node_id(p) for p, _s, _j, _u in PHASES],
    }
    (pkg_dir / "feature-package.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(package, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")

    registration = {
        "schema_version": "1.0.0",
        "source_digest": source_digest,
        "promotion_receipt": f"{PKG_DIR_REL}/atomic-promotion-receipt.json",
        "feature_package_id": PACKAGE_ID,
        "parent_feature": FEATURE,
        "expected_count": 13,
        "phase_refs": [p for p, _s, _j, _u in PHASES],
        "binding_intents": {node_id(p): "auto" for p, _s, _j, _u in PHASES},
        "nodes": nodes,
    }
    (pkg_dir / "dev-graph-registration.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(registration, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")

    config = json.loads((REPO / ".dev-graph" / "config.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    promotion = {
        "schema_version": "1.0.0",
        "status": "promoted",
        "promoted_at": NOW,
        "repo_identity": config["repository_id"],
        "staging_digest": source_digest,
        "evaluated_digest": source_digest,
        "published_digest": source_digest,
        "implementation_readiness": "complete",
        "quality_conditions": {
            "no_contradiction": "PASS", "no_missing": "PASS",
            "consistent": "PASS", "dependency_integrity": "PASS",
        },
        "promotion_method": "same-filesystem-atomic-rename",
        "registration_manifest": f"{PKG_DIR_REL}/dev-graph-registration.json",
    }
    (pkg_dir / "atomic-promotion-receipt.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(promotion, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")

    print(json.dumps({
        "source_digest": source_digest,
        "source_feature_digest": feature_digest,
        "task_artifacts": 13,
        "package": f"{PKG_DIR_REL}/feature-package.json",
        "registration": f"{PKG_DIR_REL}/dev-graph-registration.json",
        "promotion_receipt": f"{PKG_DIR_REL}/atomic-promotion-receipt.json",
        "planned_done_phases": sorted(DONE_PHASES),
    }, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

### 目的・背景 (Why)

グラフ情報を人間が俯瞰するにはゼロ依存の静的可視化が必要で、コミットまたは CI 生成可能な成果物にすることで導入先リポジトリ内で完結させるため。feature ノードは配下task (parent_feature参照) の完了進捗 (X/Y) を集約表示し、機能単位のオーケストレーション状況を俯瞰できるようにする (§8.5・epic投影を持たないlocal_only profileでも実行状況を可視化)

}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
